WITH sold AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
), cancelled AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS cancelled_units
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
), max_units AS (
  SELECT MAX(COALESCE(total_units,0)) AS max_total FROM sold
)
SELECT p.name,
       COALESCE(s.total_units,0) AS total_units,
       COALESCE(c.cancelled_units,0) AS cancelled_orders
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN sold s ON p.id = s.product_id
LEFT JOIN cancelled c ON p.id = c.product_id
JOIN max_units m ON COALESCE(s.total_units,0) = m.max_total
LIMIT 100

WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT c.id,
         c.name,
         c.email,
         COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS total_spent,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
),
avg_spend AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT cs.id,
       cs.name,
       cs.email,
       cs.total_spent,
       cs.cancelled_orders
FROM customer_spend cs, avg_spend
WHERE cs.total_spent > avg_spend.avg_spent
LIMIT 100

WITH spend AS (

         c.name,
         COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS total_spend,

ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 100
